runtime_trigger: Only from prefix state; not the current logged choice
decision_question: Which bounded action should be selected?
candidate_builder: current registry or explicit static contract
candidate_parameter_binding: same rules for every candidate; no future IDs
ambiguity_policy: clarify, defer, or multiple acceptable actions as explicitly defined
fallback: existing Harness or explicit unsupported state
expected_savings: avoidable full-path cost including parameter generation and fallback
